name: Wildcard Firestorm creates a fiery tornado that damages and knocks back nearby enemies (#11061)
contract: Firestorm280575 summons Fiery Tornado280576 for10s (duration index 1). 280576 had no creature_template, so the
cast paid its cost and spawned nothing. The tornado carries passive280577 (1000ms period) and each tick casts
280578 from the tornado for the caster: Fire damage and a knockback to enemies within6yards (radius193).
The tornado exists after the cast and is gone after its duration; the enemy beside it takes 280578 damage from
the caster and is pushed away; an enemy 25 yards away is never hit.

steps.label: Gap to the enemy before the tornado
